summary: First Eagle Private Credit Fund (FEPCF) filed an 8-K disclosing that its parent, First Eagle Holdings, will be acquired by Victory Capital Holdings. Victory Capital will acquire First Eagle Investment Management and First Eagle Alternative Credit, the Fund's adviser and subadviser. The transaction is expected to close in Q1 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and fund/client consents. This constitutes an assignment under the Investment Company Act, terminating existing advisory agreements. The Fund's Board will consider new advisory agreements with Victory Capital Management; shareholder approval is required. No deal terms, price, or premium were disclosed in the filing. Watch for Board and shareholder approval of new agreements, a key condition to closing.
